name: The Prince of Nothing
source:
Make your way as a lonely, wretched vampire in Pittsburgh. Search for friends and try not to die horribly or lose your mind. Suffer through nine possible chapters and three possible endings. Endure an original soundtrack and fully voiced lines. 

[From [url=https://billvolkgames.itch.io/the-prince-of-nothing]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在匹兹堡扮演一个孤独、可怜的吸血鬼。寻找朋友，尽量不要死得很惨或者失去理智。经历九个可能的章节和三个可能的结局。忍受原声带和全语音台词。

[来自[url=https://billvolkgames.itch.io/the-prince-of-nothing]Itch.io[/url]]
